claim_scores.rationale: Uses `DummyLM([{'answer': 'Paris'}, ...], adapter=dspy.JSONAdapter())` under an outer `dspy.ChatAdapter()`, creating the JSON-vs-chat-format mismatch.
Shows `with dspy.context(..., adapter=dspy.ChatAdapter()): out = prog(...)` succeeds and asserts `out.answer == 'Paris'`, matching transparent fallback behavior.
Explicitly proves the retry by asserting `len(lm1.history) == 2` and printing the fallback call count.
Uses `dspy.ChatAdapter(use_json_adapter_fallback=False)` for the second run, which is the no-fallback configuration requested.
Wraps the no-fallback run in `pytest`-style logic and catches `AdapterParseError`, with an assertion that failure must occur instead of success.
